newsitem.title: USA: Clinton has big lead over Dole in Reuters poll.
newsitem.headline: Clinton has big lead over Dole in Reuters poll.

text.p: President Bill Clinton, boosted by military action against Iraq and the Democratic convention, has built a lead of 14.9 percentage points over Republican Bob Dole, the Reuters poll said on Thursday.

The poll of 1,019 likely voters was conducted for Reuters by John Zogby Group International September 2-4. It gave Clinton 48.2 percent to 33.3 percent for Dole and 5.9 percent for independent Ross Perot. The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.2 percentage points.

The poll showed Clinton leading Dole in every region of the country and among every age group, income group and ethnic group. It showed his favorability rating at 61 percent, and more than half of those polled said the president deserved re-election.

During the three days of polling, Clinton benefited from a boost following his decision to order air strikes against Iraq. Clinton's support was strongest on Tuesday, the day of the first U.S. cruise missile strike against Iraq.
